Definition: an Emorite, one of the Canaanitish tribes
BiblicalUsage: The Amorites were one of the peoples of Canaan, east of the Jordan and beyond, whose land Israel inherited. Their kings Sihon and Og held the country of Gilead in 1 Kings 4:19, their cities were restored to Israel and there was peace between Israel and the Amorites in 1 Samuel 7:14, and the remnant of them were still there as forced labour in Solomon's day in 2 Chronicles 8:7.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the Amorites show both sides of God's dealings with nations — He gave them centuries of patience, and then He gave their land to Israel when their iniquity was full. I hold that no nation stands forever on its own strength, and God's promises to His people outlast every empire that stands in the way.
